desc: Read N and the list A from stdin.
Set pointers: i = 0 (tops, from first half), j = (N+1)//2 (bottoms, from second half), count = 0.
Loop while i < N//2 and j < N: if 2*A[i] <= A[j], increment count and advance both i and j; else advance j only.
Verify edge cases: N=2, all equal elements (answer 0), and confirm count never exceeds N//2 by construction.
Implement solve() reading N and list A via sys.stdin.buffer; two-pointer greedy matching tops from first half with bottoms from second half; print count; wrapped in `if __name__ == "__main__":`.
